description.es: Mientras Marta está poniendo al corriente a Santiago, entra Fina. Marta se molesta al ver a Fina, porque no quería que empezara a trabajar. Fina le dice a Marta que ella pondrá al corriente a Santiago.
description.en: As Marta is briefing Santiago, Fina comes in. Marta is annoyed when she sees Fina, because she did not want her to start working. Fina tells Marta that she will brief Santiago.
